results.title: CARC Paint Coating
blockers: Core requirement is physical application of CARC coatings with quality-control and on-site contract-performance obligations.
Solicitation includes a total small-business set-aside and DoD safeguarding/compliance clauses, creating additional eligibility friction for a foreign lean digital bidder.
results.why: Industrial coating work is outside the target delivery model and has no credible lean digital/creative execution path.
